en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘
The hearts of the ignorant ones trigger the greed, and the yearnings hold them hostage, and the deceptions attach to them’.
